changelog: v0.9.3 — Reliability fixes. Autofill: never puts profile data into the wrong question (labels are read from the field's own container; phone/state/city/zip/salary/years rules are stricter; referrer/emergency contact fields are skipped), prefers answers you taught it over the profile's, and doesn't reuse a US answer for a UK question. Panel: a CV generated for one job can't end up on another if you switch jobs mid-request; switching profile clears the previous profile's CV; a wrong password shows the right message; an expired session returns to the sign-in screen.
